say:1:1321834001:1.text: We need your help with something, Captain.
say:1:1321834001:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈先生，有一件事，我们希望能够得到你的帮助。

choice_prompt:2:1321834001.text: We need your help with something, Captain.
choice_prompt:2:1321834001.source_cn: 罗德里戈先生，有一件事，我们希望能够得到你的帮助。

say:3:1321834003:1.text: This Orla... Is she truly a descendant of the Valesa family?
say:3:1321834003:1.source_cn: 这女孩……奥尔嘉，她真的是瓦勒沙家族的后裔？
say:3:1321834003:1.male: This Orla... Is she truly a descendant of the Valesa family?
say:3:1321834003:1.female: This Orla... Is she truly a descendant of the Valesa family?

say:6:1321834005:1.text: Oh, Dura above... I can't believe this is true...
say:6:1321834005:1.source_cn: 艾雅保佑……我从没想过，我从没想过……

say:8:1321834006:1.text: Orla does not wish to leave, with her parents' grave here, but neither of us can remain for long, given our duties.
say:8:1321834006:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉的父母安葬在雪松镇的墓地，她也不愿远离这里。而我...

say:9:1321834007:1.text: Captain Rodrigo, with your deep ties to the Valesa family, would you be willing to take Orla into your care?
say:9:1321834007:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈先生，你与瓦勒沙家族有着深刻的联系。所以……你...

say:10:1321834008:1.text: My family once swore allegiance to the Valesas. As a knight, I have never forgotten that vow...
say:10:1321834008:1.source_cn: 我的家族曾起誓向瓦勒沙家族效忠，身为骑士，我也从未忘记...

say:11:1321834009:1.text: I would be honored to raise Orla if you all believe I am the right person for the task. I will do everything in my power to care for her.
say:11:1321834009:1.source_cn: 如果各位相信我的话，请让我来照顾奥尔嘉吧。哪怕是献出自...

say:12:1321834010:1.text: Orla, come meet Captain Rodrigo. He has agreed to be your guardian.
say:12:1321834010:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉，来见过罗德里戈，这位罗德里戈大人愿意成为你的监护人，

say:14:1321834011:1.text: Captain Rodrigo... Your armor looks so cool.
say:14:1321834011:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈……你的……你的铠甲很漂亮。

say:15:1321834012:1.text: Thank you, Orla. From now on, Cedartown will be your home.
say:15:1321834012:1.source_cn: 谢谢，奥尔嘉。从今天开始，雪松镇就是你的家了。

choice_prompt:16:1321834012.text: Thank you, Orla. From now on, Cedartown will be your home.
choice_prompt:16:1321834012.source_cn: 谢谢，奥尔嘉。从今天开始，雪松镇就是你的家了。

say:18:1321834013:1.text: With that helmet on, you wouldn't even know if he's smiling!
say:18:1321834013:1.source_cn: 可是他戴着头盔，笑了也看不到啊！
say:18:1321834013:1.male: With that helmet on, you wouldn't even know if he's smiling!
say:18:1321834013:1.female: With that helmet on, you wouldn't even know if he's smiling!

say:20:1321834016:1.text: Rodrigo, I need you to do something for me.
say:20:1321834016:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈，我有一个请求。

say:21:1321834017:1.text: Orla is too young to understand the significance of this family name and the pressure that comes with it.
say:21:1321834017:1.source_cn: 奥尔嘉的年纪还小，她还不理解这个姓氏意味着什么，也不该...

say:22:1321834018:1.text: So, it'd be best not to tell her about her heritage just yet. Wait till she's older, I'll explain everything to her myself.
say:22:1321834018:1.source_cn: 所以请你暂时不要将她的身世告诉她，直到她长大，直到她做...

say:24:1321834020:1.text: I am entrusting Orla to you, Captain Rodrigo, the most loyal knight of the Valesa family.
say:24:1321834020:1.source_cn: 你是瓦勒沙家族最忠心的骑士，请你照顾好她。

say:25:1321834021:1.text: I swear on my life, she will be well cared for.
say:25:1321834021:1.source_cn: 我以我的生命起誓，我会好好照顾她的，子爵大人。

say:26:1321834022:5.text: Orla, Captain Rodrigo will take you to your new home. There will be a cozy fireplace, a comfortable bed, and hot soup waiting for you.
say:26:1321834022:5.source_cn: 奥尔嘉，跟罗德里戈走吧，他会领你去你的新家。家里会有温...

say:27:1321834023:1.text: Faramor... Will you visit me at my new home?
say:27:1321834023:1.source_cn: 那……法拉莫尔，那你会去我的新家看我吗？

say:28:1321834024:1.text: Of course, Orla. I'll keep my promise. I'll be there whenever you need me.
say:28:1321834024:1.source_cn: 我会的，奥尔嘉。我不会忘记自己的承诺。只要你需要，我就会来。

say:29:1321834025:1.text: Great! Thank you, Faramor and everyone else.
say:29:1321834025:1.source_cn: 嗯！谢谢你，法拉莫尔。谢谢你们。

say:31:1321834026:1.text: Thank you so much, my friends. Come on, Orla, let's head home.
say:31:1321834026:1.source_cn: 诸位朋友，非常感谢你们。来吧，奥尔嘉，我们回家。

say:33:1321834027:1.text: I'm satisfied with how this has turned out.
say:33:1321834027:1.source_cn: 这件事总算有了个好结果，这样我也就能安心了。

say:35:1321834014:1.text: Apologies... I'm just accustomed to maintaining a serious demeanor.
say:35:1321834014:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我之前习惯了严肃的生活和工作……
say:35:1321834014:1.male: Apologies... I'm just accustomed to maintaining a serious demeanor.
say:35:1321834014:1.female: Apologies... I'm just accustomed to maintaining a serious demeanor.

choice:16:1:2.text: Can you loosen up a little?
choice:16:1:2.male: Can you loosen up a little?
choice:16:1:2.female: Can you loosen up a little?

say:37:1321834015:1.text: Exactly! If you're gentle like Mr. Faramor, Orla will definitely warm up to you!
say:37:1321834015:1.source_cn: 对呀，要学习法拉莫尔先生，像他那样温柔，奥尔嘉肯定会喜欢的！

say:38:1321834002:1.text: What? Is there another Valesa descendant?!
say:38:1321834002:1.source_cn: 什么？！可是亚莲娜殿下已经……瓦勒沙家族还有后裔？
say:38:1321834002:1.male: What? Is there another Valesa descendant?!
say:38:1321834002:1.female: What? Is there another Valesa descendant?!

choice_prompt:39:1321834002.source_cn: 什么？！可是亚莲娜殿下已经……瓦勒沙家族还有后裔？
choice_prompt:39:1321834002.male: What? Is there another Valesa descendant?!
choice_prompt:39:1321834002.female: What? Is there another Valesa descendant?!

choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你想不想见见瓦勒沙家族的后裔？
